name: SP-404MKII
about: Roland's sampler and effector with 16 pads per bank, ten banks and five FX buses.
source: Roland SP-404MK2 Reference Manual (applicable to version 4.00), MIDI implementation chart (v4.04, Apr. 4, 2024), p. 268-273, https://static.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/SP-404MK2_v4_reference_eng02_W.pdf
notes: Pad notes and channel are MIDI mode A, bank A on channel 1: pads 1-4 are notes 48-51 (the bottom row is 13-16, notes 36-39), and bank B..J are channels 2..10 with the same notes (the chart's note-map layout); set the MIDI mode in UTILITY > SYSTEM > MIDI. In MIDI mode B the notes run across banks instead (12-91). The chart's default channel entry is ambiguous. The FX CCs address a bus by channel: 1-4 are buses 1-4 and 5 is Input FX, so one profile channel (1 = bus 1) reaches one bus; CC 83 picks the effect by number (see the manual's effect list). CC 7 and 8 work in DJ mode, buttons 85-89 in Looper mode on channel 1. Program change PC 0-15 picks pattern 1-16 of the bank given by the channel (example in the chart: PC 15 on channel 4 is Bank D pattern 16). Chart does not list a Bank Select.
